english.title: Premises licence holder fail to secure licence / certified copy held on premises - Licensing
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of the premises licence for **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES AND LOCATION..), failed without reasonable excuse to secure that the licence or a certified copy of it was kept at the premises

(A)_[in your custody or under your control]_
(B)_[in the custody or under the control of a person who works at the premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), nominated by you in writing for that purpose]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 57(4) and (8) of the Licensing Act 2003.
